data.title: 厄普西隆 · 空旷音乐厅的月光独奏
data.description: 巨型花窗透入皎洁月华的演奏大厅内，厄普西隆端坐于三角钢琴前。修长的指尖流转于黑白琴键之上，神情高贵圣洁，侧首回眸的眼神充满柔情。
data.location: grand gothic concert hall with giant rose window casting moonlight on polished ebony stage
data.action: sitting at grand piano, slender fingers dancing over keys, head turned back with serene aristocrat gaze
data.lighting: 空旷音乐厅高耸拱窗倾泻的皎洁月光与舞台地灯
data.mood: classical artistic elegance, pure romantic reverence, moonlit serenade
data.promptProse: At a grand piano in the concert hall, blue-haired elf Epsilon in a velvet gown plays with graceful elegance. A soft beam of moonlight through the stained-glass window illuminates her face, hands, and piano.
data.animaCaption: Pure silver moonbeams stream through the cathedral-height windows, spotlighting her elegant hands upon the grand piano keys.
